observed: One unmeasured cross-section of soil, with an uneven ground surface and diagonal hatching immediately beneath it.
Two narrow pore corridors open at the ground surface; the left is nearer the middle, the right is near the right edge.

Both corridors are partially filled with liquid shown by horizontal hatch strokes. The left wet region widens downward-left and meets branching lower boundaries; the longer right wet region slopes/widens downward-left.
Irregular grain/boundary curves connect and branch below the surface. Openings and wet channels interrupt the top boundary rather than becoming sealed vertical cylinders.
No flow arrows, labelled grain species, grid, lengths, water table, time, calibrated pore diameters, or measured fluid routes.
uncertainties: Unlabelled source boundary strokes do not establish a complete measured pore network or a unique water-flow route.
